req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with the same body for the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the PUT operation should be idempotent, meaning that repeated requests with the same data should not alter the state beyond the initial application. This is crucial for ensuring consistency in RESTful APIs. The test suite includes a positive test to confirm idempotency, a negative test to handle non-existent task IDs, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid input.

tests.name: test_put_idempotency_positive
preconditions: A task with task_id=1 exists in the system.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with task_id=1.
Send the same PUT request again with the same data.
expected: The task state remains unchanged after the second request.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Update the task
update_data = {"title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated Description", "completed": True}
response1 = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json=update_data)
assert response1.status_code == 200

# Action: Repeat the update
response2 = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json=update_data)
assert response2.status_code == 200

# Expected: Verify idempotency
assert response1.json() == response2.json()

tests.name: test_put_idempotency_negative
actions: Send a PUT request to update a non-existent task with task_id=9999.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_data = {"title": "Non-existent Task", "description": "This task does not exist", "completed": False}
response = client.put("/tasks/9999", json=update_data)

# Expected: Verify 404 response
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 9999 not found"

tests.name: test_put_idempotency_boundary
preconditions: A task with task_id=1 exists in the system.
actions: Send a PUT request with minimal valid data to update the task with task_id=1.
expected: The task is updated with minimal valid data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Update the task with minimal valid data
update_data = {"title": "B", "completed": True}
response = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json=update_data)

# Expected: Verify update with minimal data
assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task['title'] == "B"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True
